title: Brazilian Portuguese - Food, Drink & Culinary Culture Subject Matter Expert (SME)
description: Project Overview Help shape the future of AI in Brazil! We are building a next‑generation benchmark to evaluate how well AI systems handle complex, real‑world questions in Brazilian Portuguese. This project will help improve how AI delivers accurate, reliable, and context‑aware responses for the Brazilian market. We are seeking Brazilian Portuguese Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) in Food, Drink & Culinary Culture to create high-quality, expert-level question-and-answer content. This role goes beyond basic data labeling and requires deep domain knowledge, critical thinking, and strong writing skills to test advanced reasoning and contextual understanding in Brazilian Portuguese. Suitable backgrounds may includeculinary arts, gastronomy, food journalism, beverage culture, hospitality, nutrition, lifestyle media, restaurant management, or cultural commentary focused on Brazilian food and dining traditions. Relevant profiles could include chefs, food critics, culinary researchers, restaurant professionals, nutrition specialists, beverage experts, food content creators, hospitality professionals, or individuals with recognized experience analyzing or shaping Brazilian culinary and lifestyle culture. Please submit your resume/CV in English.
min_qualifications: Native or fluent proficiency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) 5–10+ years of professional experience in a relevant field Demonstrated expertise through academic background and/or industry experience Strong analytical skills and the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear, structured manner Excellent written communication skills and attention to detail Ability to work independently and deliver high-quality output in a guideline-driven environment Nice to Have Experience with content creation, research, education, or knowledge evaluation Familiarity with AI training, data annotation, or evaluation projects Background in interdisciplinary work (e.g. cultural anthropology, history, sociology, sustainability, gastronomy and lifestyle studies) #LI-CAN17
